artifacts.name: Business Overview — Daily Briefing
artifacts.description: Today's whole CRM picture in one refreshable page — pipeline by stage, this week's new leads, your overdue and due-today activities, today's calendar, tasks due this week, and the latest team notes. Refresh re-runs business_overview_data against Odoo as you.

artifacts.name: Leads — Inbound Prospects
artifacts.description: Your open Odoo CRM leads as a live, refreshable table — contact, email, stage, expected revenue, probability and salesperson. Refresh re-runs crm_lead_search against Odoo as you, so Odoo's own record rules decide what appears.

artifacts.name: Pipeline — Open Deals
artifacts.description: Your open Odoo CRM opportunities as a live, refreshable table — stage, expected revenue, probability, creation date and salesperson. Refresh re-runs crm_lead_search against Odoo as you, so Odoo's own record rules decide what appears.

artifacts.name: Recent Activity — Team Notes
artifacts.description: The latest chatter across every Odoo record as a live, searchable feed — who wrote what, on which record, and when. Refresh re-runs note_search against Odoo as you, so Odoo's own record rules decide what appears.

artifacts.name: To-Do Bulletin
artifacts.description: Everything waiting on the team as one live checklist: your Odoo activities (overdue first, tick to complete with feedback) and open project tasks with deadlines. Refresh re-runs activity_list and task_list against Odoo as you.

artifacts.name: Knowledge Feed — brain@ Activity
artifacts.description: Everything the brain@ pipeline has captured into the knowledge bank as a live feed — each document with its source, pipeline status, category, and summary, newest first. Refresh re-runs list_documents against the knowledge bank.

artifacts.name: Team Inbox — Messages & Live Sessions
artifacts.description: Unread messages addressed to you, and the directory of agent sessions running right now with the handle to reach each one. Refresh re-runs comms_inbox and comms_sessions as you, so you only ever see what was addressed to you.
